guitar.modelsText: "Arm the Homeless" guitar / Fender Telecaster / Squier Strat-style guitars
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Tom Morello's custom "Arm the Homeless" guitar (Strat-style with humbucker) is famous, along with his use of toggle-switch-modified Telecasters.
guitar.notes: Very well documented — should not have been unknown.

tone.summary: A high-gain, punchy rhythm tone achieved with a Boost/OD pedal for grit, followed by the UK 45 or UK 50 model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet to deliver aggressive, mid-focused rock crunch suitable for palm-muted chugging.

rig.name: Rage Against The Machine - Killing in the Name - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise during aggressive playing.
Provide necessary mid-hump and grit for tight palm-muted chugging without excessive fuzz.
blocks.gap: The Boost is used to simulate a slight overdrive/boost effect, mimicking the punch of an OD pedal while keeping the tone focused on mids.

alternatives.reason: A more traditional choice for rock grit.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive saturation and bite to the rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated high-gain pedal would be ideal, RAT-style provides the necessary mid-range aggression without sounding overly scooped or fuzzy.

alternatives.reason: A more general choice for rock crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the punchy, mid-forward character of a Marshall Plexi/British rock amp.
blocks.gap: None. This model is ideal for classic aggressive rock tones.

alternatives.reason: A close alternative, but UK 50 often provides a slightly punchier mid-range.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary mid-range punch.
blocks.gap: None. This is the standard choice for this genre/vibe.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the upper mids to ensure maximum presence and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: None. Used for surgical tone shaping.

blocks.purpose: Bypass the wah module as per musical verdict requirements.
Bypass modulation effects to maintain a raw, aggressive sound.
Bypass delay to keep the tone dry and punchy.
Bypass reverb to maintain a dry, aggressive sound.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more authentic British 4x12 to enhance mid-range punch and aggression.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, mid-forward punch required for RATM's rhythm tone.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and bite in chugging riffs.
